author: Virginia Woolf
title: A Room of One’s Own
edition: London: published by Leonard and Virginia Woolf at the Hogarth Press, 1929; printed by R. & R. Clark, Edinburgh. Scan-backed Wikisource transcription of the identified 1929 edition, not the undated later printing of Mrs Dalloway. Navigation, page markers and note-call anchors excluded; prose whitespace collapsed; displayed verse/list lines retained. The library text holds Chapters I to VI with the book's title and chapter headings, ending with THE END; the title page and list of the author's other books are omitted, and so are Woolf's thirteen footnotes. Indentation inside quoted verse is kept as the transcription's em spaces.

rights.basis: The identified Hogarth English-language edition was published in 1929, before 1931, and is in the US public domain as of 2026. The source reproduces the dated title page and declares US public-domain status. No modern introduction or annotation is included.

acquisition.method: Wikisource rendered page HTML (index.php action=render) for the six chapter subpages in printed order, A Room of One's Own (Hogarth 1929)/Chapter 1 to Chapter 6 (revisions 14907454, 14907457, 14909051, 14909273, 14909241, 14909251); downloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of the six responses concatenated in that order and downloadUrl the first of them. Only the transcluded scan text is used: Wikisource headers, page-number anchors, footnote markers and lists, gap spacers and zero-width page-boundary characters removed; the book title and chapter numbers became headings; other centred lines and paragraphs became paragraphs with whitespace collapsed; quoted verse and lists became stanza blocks, one line per line break, split at blank lines; emphasis flattened.
